jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production character master for Muerta Poker, Spine Professional rigging, concept A Reaper Dealer. Input 1 is the APPROVED character identity and costume reference, input 2 is the game's own gold Reaper skull identity, input 3 is the game's own graphic court-card line/shade reference. Create a new definitive production master of A, genuine transparent background, no scene/no UI. Target a 1600x2800 portrait PNG (2400-3000 px tall master), crisp high-resolution printed edges. Waist-up, narrow tall silhouette, 3/4 view facing RIGHT toward the field, both complete hands visible. Strong oversized sugar-skull head 1.6x normal proportions, recognizably the same ivory skull with oxblood fleur/marigold face markings, symmetrical facial ornament projected naturally in 3/4 view. Black hood with deep oxblood lining, hood front flows as one continuous crown-to-shoulders panel with broad deformation-friendly folds. Long front cloak is a continuous broad panel, no tiny segmented fabric strips. Ornate black/oxblood dealer waistcoat, high upright collar, restrained marigold-gold embroidery and gold trim, one marigold boutonniere with two narrow ribbon tails. Skull neck and shoulders have clear anatomy. Both arms separated from the torso by clean contours; generous cloth at elbows. Near arm (viewer RIGHT) bent at elbow with a complete ivory skeletal hand naturally supporting a compact blank-backed oxblood/gold deck at waist; far arm (viewer LEFT) relaxed at the side, bent gently with a complete relaxed skeletal hand visible beside waist. All hands anatomically coherent with exactly five digits and carefully inked knuckles, no crossed/intertwined fingers. Natural relaxed setup pose, readable shoulder/elbow/wrist pivots. No separate loose card in default master: holding-card swap comes later. Key light warm overhead from TOP LEFT, flat warm ivory value planes, crisp cel shadow bottom right, a subtle edge highlight. Funeral-print/tattoo card illustration, bold ink outlines consistent with card example, clean flat colour and cel shading, NOT photorealism, NOT airbrushed/3D. Keep headwear and all fingers complete; waist-up ends in a deliberate smooth cloak/waistcoat silhouette, not a random rectangular crop. No text, letters, titles, ranks, suit marks, logos, watermark, background, floor, glow fog or shadow outside the silhouette. Preserve the approved character's identity, palette and costume language; refine anatomy and broad continuous panels for production. Output one complete unlabelled master on true alpha.
